text: Exemplar links on Grafana panels jumped from a histogram bucket straight into the matching Tempo trace; mean time to root-cause a latency spike fell from 15 minutes to 90 seconds.
Started Brazilian jiu-jitsu at Gracie Barra in January; earned the first stripe on my white belt last week.
Delta-delta encoding on the timestamp column of the ClickHouse MergeTree table cut the on-disk metrics footprint by 62 percent versus plain LZ4.
The annual jewellery audit on 2026-01-04 turned up four pieces unworn in two years: sent the silver bangle and the cufflinks to Rebus for melt-and-recast credit toward a new pinky ring.
The first-phone negotiation landed on 2026-04-02: a Nokia 2660 flip for calls and texts only, no smartphone until year seven.
Handed back the Redland keys to the agent on 2026-04-09 at Hopewell Lettings; signed the inventory snag list with four pencilled corrections.
Joy hit when the 2026-03-09 book-club Discord call on Piranesi ran Zoom-in-Discord-embed cleanly across five people and the Storygraph buddy-read badge popped for all of us.
Strangler migration of the legacy PHP app wrapped on 2026-03-12 after 14 months; Symfony served the last surviving admin pages behind Nginx.

Moved mom's voice-banking archive off the iPhone Voice Memos into the ModelTalker platform on 2026-03-25 because ModelTalker can actually synthesize her voice back onto the Tobii Dynavox after the laryngeal cancer progression.
GraphQL Codegen produces typed hooks via the client-preset; useOrderQuery now returns a fully typed data field and the old any-typed responses were deleted.
The i18n README now points at a runnable `pnpm i18n:doctor` script that checks catalog parity, plural coverage, and ICU syntax in one pass; new contributors ran it successfully on day one.
Joy hit the first time the Goodnight scene actually worked end-to-end: lights down, Aqara U100 thrown, Ecobee dropped to 18 C, and the Reolink notifications armed.
Problem-based learning, launched at McMaster University's medical programme in 1969, replaces front-loaded lectures with ill-structured clinical cases as the curricular unit.
Replaced print-and-pray panic recovery with structured slog handlers in every Go binary; panics now produce a json line with goroutine id, request id, and a clipped stack.
Frances Arnold's directed evolution programme at Caltech, reviewed in Nature in 2001, reframed enzyme engineering around iterative mutation and screening and seeded her 2018 Nobel citation.
Docker Desktop on macOS used a LinuxKit VM under Apple Virtualization Framework; the switch from HyperKit trimmed CPU use in idle by about 30 percent.
Satisfaction hit on 2026-03-31 when the quarterly review pulled 47 evergreen notes written since January out of the vault and the monthly mood chart actually correlated with the fiction-reading tag.
Grothendieck's 1957 Tohoku paper introduced abelian categories and derived functors, superseding the ad hoc spectral-sequence calculations of the Cartan-Eilenberg era.
WHEP served the low-latency viewer egress; viewers on the public site connected in under 800 ms versus 6-8 seconds on the old DASH player.
Joy hit when the Synology family share survived a power surge because Wojtek had insisted on the UPS last autumn.
The will with Hemsworth Solicitors was updated on 2026-02-11; added a letter of wishes about cremation, kept the charitable gift to Marie Curie intact.
Helped Mum move into the Lisbon assisted-living flat on 2025-10-12; she settled in faster than expected.
Triangle counting on the GDS library surfaced the clustering coefficient bump on the co-purchase graph; the Louvain community shift matched the holiday basket mix.
Leo's first loose tooth came out on 2026-03-22 at the dinner table into a slice of pear; tooth fairy left £2 under the pillow.
Booking.com replaced Airbnb for the 2026-04-20 Buenos Aires stay after three Airbnb listings canceled within 48 hours of arrival and the free-cancellation hotel finally calmed the panic.
Replaced the old 2017 Specialized Sirrus with a Trek FX 3 Disc on 2026-02-08 after the Sirrus frame cracked at the bottom bracket weld.
Joy hit hard at the 2026-02-20 Four Tet show at Brooklyn Steel because Bandsintown's pre-sale alert fired 40 minutes before Songkick's and the tickets cleared before the code expired.
Calm settled back in after the Eero Secure family profile plus the NextDNS logs showed zero unfiltered requests from my teen Hadi's Windows gaming rig all of last week.
Booked the motorbike CBT for 2026-05-02 at Thundersley Training; the plan is the A2 test by autumn so the Honda CB500F becomes legal.
Idempotency tokens on Step Functions Task states landed across the integrations on 2026-04-02; duplicate StartExecution calls from the upstream API now collapsed safely.
Finally shipped the Whisper-powered Substack newsletter on 2026-03-22 that summarises each Decoder episode into bullet points for Tomas's reading habit.
Migrated the Rust ingest module from unwrap-everywhere to Result types with thiserror; every fallible call site now propagates a typed IngestError instead of crashing the worker.
Arte Povera, theorised by Germano Celant in 1967, embraced humble materials like earth, burlap, and neon against commodified art.
Parquet encryption with uniform mode was shipped on 2026-02-14; the footer-only key wrap kept the reader path simple versus per-column encryption.
Dobbs v Jackson Women's Health Organization, decided by the United States Supreme Court in 2022, replaced the abortion-rights framework of Roe v Wade and Planned Parenthood v Casey.

The Final Fantasy XIV free trial WoL Maya is up to Endwalker on 2026-03-26 because the new Dawntrail subscription started and the Mare Synchronos plugin finally rendered Eorzea Collection mods correctly.
The LIGO collaboration announced GW150914 in Physical Review Letters in 2016, the first direct detection of gravitational waves from a binary black-hole merger.
The 1918 Spanish influenza pandemic killed an estimated 50 million people worldwide and remains the benchmark scenario in modern pandemic preparedness planning.

Joy surged on 2026-04-05 when the Pixieset gallery for the Santorini elopement crossed 600 favorite taps, and the Printique auto-order pulled the winning shot into a 30-inch Fujiflex print the same night.
Hip MRI on 2026-04-03 showed mild labral wear; the orthopedist said no surgery, focus on strength work.
Rolled out Trusted Types policies on the admin SPA; every DOM sink now goes through a named policy and raw string assignment to innerHTML throws in production.
Finally automated the bill-splitting spreadsheet with a Google Apps Script macro on 2026-03-30.
Barry Mazur's 1977 IHES paper classifying torsion subgroups of rational elliptic curves produced the celebrated Mazur torsion theorem.
Harry Hess's 1962 History of Ocean Basins paper proposed seafloor spreading, supplying the mechanism that Wegener's continental drift had lacked.
Carl Woese's 1977 PNAS paper on ribosomal RNA phylogenetics established Archaea as a third domain of life alongside Bacteria and Eukarya.
OpenMP parallel for replaced a hand-written pthread fan-out in the simulation kernel; the schedule(dynamic, 64) clause smoothed out the imbalance on irregular workloads.
SLAC's deep inelastic scattering experiments of 1968 and 1969, analysed by Bjorken and Feynman, provided the first evidence for point-like partons inside the proton.
The morning pages habit locked in after 63 consecutive days; three A4 sides at the kitchen table, long-hand, before looking at any feed.
MuseScore 4 rendered the violin arrangement for the niece's recital on 2026-04-05 and exported a MIDI for the accompanist.
The Memphis Group, formed in Milan in 1981 around Ettore Sottsass, rejected corporate modernism with colourful laminate postmodern objects.
Grafana Cloud trial started on 2026-03-18 with Mimir, Loki, and Tempo bundled; the 4-day self-hosted-to-cloud migration beat the internal build-a-stack estimate by two quarters.
Scrobbling moved from Last.fm to ListenBrainz on 2026-03-09 after the Last.fm Spotify bridge silently stopped logging podcasts and the lifetime count froze for a week.
The platform IaC cut-over landed on 2026-04-07; OpenTofu plus Argo CD plus Crossplane replaced the Terraform plus Flux v1 plus custom-operator stack across 11 clusters.
The Belmont Report, issued by the National Commission for the Protection of Human Subjects in 1979, distilled research ethics into respect for persons, beneficence, and justice.
The 2026-04-05 Juno puppy-class graduation in the Pupford app unlocked the nosework module that the Dogo subscription never offered at any tier.
Leo's reading level hit pink book band on 2026-03-15 after six weeks of paired reading each night; Priya tracked it in the parent-school diary.
The Sudbury Neutrino Observatory reported in Physical Review Letters in 2001 that solar neutrinos change flavour en route to Earth, confirming neutrino oscillations.
Francis Collins and the International Human Genome Sequencing Consortium published the finished human reference sequence in Nature in 2004, improving on the 2001 draft assembly.
Willis Carrier's 1902 air-conditioning patent introduced controlled dehumidification to industrial printing and seeded the HVAC research field.
The feeling of being 'at home' in Berlin finally clicked on 2026-02-27 at the Turmstraße U-Bahn when I corrected a tourist's platform direction without thinking about it in German first.
Bartlett's 1962 synthesis of xenon hexafluoroplatinate shattered the dogma that noble gases are chemically inert.
The International Style, codified by the 1932 MoMA exhibition curated by Hitchcock and Johnson, promoted volume, regularity, and the rejection of applied ornament.
The confirmation at St Alban's on 2025-05-04 with Bishop Thornton as officiant; sponsor was my godmother Claire, confirmation name chosen was Teresa.
Closed the v2 shared base at 6998 rows across 140 parallel-agent batches, then emitted a final 2-row top-up to lock the corpus at exactly 7000 for downstream training.
Added an accessibility audit step using axe-core against the rendered preview; missing alt text and low-contrast tokens now block merge like any other CI check.
Edwin Hubble's 1929 paper in PNAS reported the linear distance-velocity relation for galaxies, providing the empirical basis for cosmic expansion.
Reached one year sober on 2026-04-07 after starting the program with Jess.
Node problem detector feeds DaemonSet events into Alertmanager; a recurring NVMe wear flag pulled a box early.
Rewired the V8 heap snapshot pipeline into a nightly CI job; leak regressions now fail the build the day they land, not two weeks later.
BPF CO-RE let us ship a single eBPF binary across kernel versions without recompile; operator pain during rollouts dropped to near zero.
Deleted the TikTok account on 2026-03-20 after the third weekend lost to the algorithm; kept Instagram on a read-only web-only toehold.
The 2026-02-04 Copilot update added the Apple Card transaction feed natively, which replaced the weekly PDF-to-CSV Hazel workflow on the Mac.
BuildBuddy handled the remote-execution farm for the Bazel monorepo; p95 action wall time halved once the self-hosted executors came online in us-east-2.

Pride hit when my daughter Selene's Scratch project shipped to the 2026-04-11 school coding fair after a month of pair-programming sessions aimed at the ship-one-public-project goal we set in January.
Atmos layout moved to 5.1.4 on 2025-11-19 when the two extra Klipsch RP-500SA ceiling-bounce modules got mounted on the rear surrounds behind the couch.
Feng Zhang's January 2013 Science paper demonstrated CRISPR-Cas9 editing in mammalian cells at the Broad Institute, extending Doudna and Charpentier's biochemistry to human cell lines.
The milestone reunion for the 2006 uni cohort landed on 2026-07-11 at The Red Lion in Durham; 28 of 54 replied yes, the old pub quiz team is back together.
Calm settled in after the 2026-03-28 wiring redo finally ran eARC-rated HDMI 2.1 cables from the LG C2 through the Denon to the Panasonic UB820 without the occasional audio dropout.
Bumped the bcrypt cost factor from 10 to 12 on the auth service; the migration re-hashes passwords lazily on successful login rather than forcing a mass reset.
Joined the Catechumenate at St Alban's on 2026-02-14; weekly Thursday classes with Deacon Margaret Holbrook until Easter Vigil reception in 2027.
Enrolled in the Warwick evening MBA cohort starting 2026-09-14; two years part-time, Monday and Thursday sessions on the Coventry campus.
Contributed $8,300 to the family HSA on 2026-01-05 before the employer match window closed; HDHP coverage starts in February for the full year.
Spike-timing-dependent plasticity, characterised by Bi and Poo in 1998, updates synaptic weights according to the millisecond order of pre- and post-synaptic firing.
Grafana Pyroscope's diff mode between two deploy tags caught a regression in a templating helper before the synthetic monitor fired.

The 2017 Pulitzer Prize for Explanatory Reporting, shared by the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists, Sueddeutsche Zeitung, and McClatchy for the Panama Papers, canonised cross-border collaborative investigation.
Returned to the University of Leeds for a part-time MSc in Health Economics on 2026-01-15, 19 years after the original BA finished.
Dad moved into our spare room after his hip surgery on 2026-01-08; the stay was meant for six weeks.

Cattime's breed tracker app replaced the Pet Notebook entries for the ragdoll Kumo because Cattime's growth-chart overlay against breed-standard weight flagged the hyperthyroid trend two months before the MyVCA blood panel confirmed it.
Riverside.fm replaced the Zoom H6 local backup habit after the automatic double-ender saved the 2026-02-12 episode when the internet dropped halfway.
The values clarification done on 2026-01-29 with Dr Halpern surfaced four anchors: craft, candour, contact, contribution; pinned to the office wall.
Renode simulated the nRF52 plus BME280 board in CI on 2026-02-18; hardware-in-the-loop queues drained after the switch.
The Materials Research Society, founded in 1973 at Penn State, convenes engineering research bridging metallurgy, ceramics, and semiconductor processing.
Alertmanager's inhibition rules silenced downstream alerts during the upstream database outage; pager volume dropped from 230 pages to 4 during the 90-minute event.
Joy flooded the room when Leila read her first Polish sentence on 2026-03-11 after six months of Duolingo with me.
Cooking class with Signora Rosa in Bologna on 2026-09-14 covers tortellini and the real ragù, not the tourist one.
Airflow's REST API replaced the experimental endpoints in 2.0; the Stable API gave the internal portal a contract that did not break across point releases.
Albert Bandura's 1961 Bobo doll experiments at Stanford demonstrated that children acquire aggressive behaviour through observational learning rather than direct reinforcement alone.
Brown v Board of Education, decided in 1954 by the United States Supreme Court under Chief Justice Earl Warren, replaced the separate-but-equal doctrine of Plessy v Ferguson.
Boundary session recording captured a misbehaving admin session for the incident review on 2026-03-09; playback was in-browser.
DeepMind's AlphaGo defeated Lee Sedol 4-1 in Seoul in March 2016, the first program to beat a top human Go professional on a full nineteen by nineteen board.
